# MyEVStation

> Veteran-led EV charging infrastructure and station partnership opportunities in India. Founded by Ex-Indian Air Force.

MyEVStation helps prospective partners explore electric vehicle charging station models and understand the practical questions involved before investing. Options include no-land host-location models, landowner and commercial-property sites, housing-society charging, and an ex-servicemen-focused business opportunity. Site suitability, costs, availability, commercial terms and returns depend on technical assessment and written agreements. Illustrative figures are not guaranteed.

## Main pages

- [Why MyEVStation](https://myevstation.co/why-myevstation): Our approach to EV charging site suitability, planning and partnerships.
- [Business models](https://myevstation.co/business-model): Compare pathways for landowners, no-land investors, societies and ex-servicemen.
- [Technology](https://myevstation.co/technology): EV charger selection, electrical readiness and safety considerations.
- [Investment guide](https://myevstation.co/ev-charging-investment-guide): Site feasibility, cost drivers and investment questions.

- [Home](https://myevstation.co/): EV charging station models, technology overview, investment calculator and partner options.
- [No-land model](https://myevstation.co/without-land): Indicative equipment packages, charger prices and operating assumptions.
- [Landowners](https://myevstation.co/with-land): Site assessment considerations for plots, commercial properties, parking areas and fleet locations.
- [Housing societies](https://myevstation.co/society): Smart sockets, AC and DC charger options, indicative equipment pricing and installation planning.
- [Ex-servicemen](https://myevstation.co/ex-servicemen): Veteran-focused opportunity overview, illustrative packages and site assessment process.
- [XML sitemap](https://myevstation.co/sitemap.xml): Public indexable pages.
